objective: Make the strict external evaluator handoff derive its tracked-source artifact digest from an exact Git commit.
actions: Implemented a commit-only `git archive --format=tar` source artifact builder and validator.
Bound the resulting SHA-256 into the existing strict external evaluation request.
Excluded dirty working-tree and untracked state by construction.
Added CLI and regression tests for invariance, commit sensitivity, request binding, tampering, canonical commit ids, and round-trip validation.
Merged only after exact-head CI success.
observations: PR 146 eliminated result-to-request reassignment, while PR 150 removes an opaque manual source-artifact digest step from request construction.
The handoff still does not itself create an independent evaluator, hidden suite, signature, or production result.
claims: The source archive digest in a strict external evaluation handoff can now be reconstructed from an exact commit without consuming dirty or untracked local state.
This is evaluation scaffolding, not evidence that AGI was achieved.
